entry_points.summary: Read-only Sonnet single-dimension auditor; writes findings file, returns counts.
Haiku mechanical bisect runner; returns offending SHA+diff; refuses destructive repros and interpretive work.
/z-plan-split leaf planner; writes cluster SPEC/PLAN/TASKS, escalates risky decisions.
Haiku task classifier returning low|medium|high for model routing.
Primary provider proxy; supports 12 modes including generate-hypotheses-round1/round2-adversarial.
Secondary provider proxy; same 12-mode surface as primary, distinct provider role.
Read-only Haiku fetcher over INDEX/concept JSON/MEMORIES-FLAT.md; returns synthesis.
Refreshes one concept doc pair; preserves memories[] verbatim; dry-run default; dedup_tags support.
Haiku web/API retrieval worker; emits lookup-contract envelope; verb-blocklist enforced.
Implements one task block; supports --tasks path override, cross_task_notes, tests_md_path; mandatory self-check.
Sonnet branch-diff quality reviewer; deep=true triggers Opus abstraction sub-pass; dedup+consensus+dismissal merge.
Sonnet plan artifact style reviewer; 7 categories; multi-voice; returns fenced JSON+Summary.
Haiku advisory router for ambiguous plan-family decisions; parseable route contract.
Haiku mechanical remote verifier: sandbox builds, paper checks, logs, read-only DB.
Haiku post-run memory candidate generator; debug_md_path primary for debug runs; slug anti-patterns enforced.
Provider proxy for task correctness/spec review; accepts relevant_docs LLM JSONs; blockers+majors only return.
Haiku Phase-0 scope classifier for z-audit and z-brainstorm; returns LIGHT/MEDIUM/HEAVY + axis + chunks manifest; advisory only.
Sonnet post-fanout reconciler for HEAVY z-audit runs; dedupes N per-chunk findings, preserves cross-chunk dissent verbatim, elevates systemic findings; never writes to disk.
Sonnet post-fanout reconciler for HEAVY z-brainstorm runs; concatenates N per-chunk BRAINSTORM.md files verbatim, runs cross-chunk anti-bias check; sets chosen_framing: pending for user selection.
Haiku preflight verifier for SPEC references; uses relevant_docs LLM JSONs as second source of truth.

invariants: Each agent is spawned fresh per invocation; callers pass all required context.
Commands/skills own orchestration, user interaction, artifact writes, and final routing decisions.
consultant-primary, consultant-secondary, and reviewer resolve providers via scripts/resolve-provider.sh.
Proxy agents emit consult_start before provider calls so liveness checks can detect hangs.
doc-updater must preserve existing memories[] verbatim and never author memories.
external-lookup must follow docs/llm/lookup-contract.json and refuse mutating commands.
planning-router is read-only and advisory; malformed or unsafe routing returns ask_user/bad_input.
mr-reviewer reviews quality, not correctness, and returns JSON for the orchestrator to write.
plan-style-reviewer reviews design-quality of plan artifacts, not correctness; never finds logic/correctness/race-condition bugs.
plan-style-reviewer never writes PLAN_STYLE_AUDIT.md; orchestrator does.
plan-style-reviewer style-drift findings must cite a STYLE.md rule ID; premature-abstraction findings must cite file:line.
remote-runner executes mechanical checks only; interpretive debugging returns to the caller.
cluster-planner refuses nested plan-split outputs when an ancestor MANIFEST.md exists.
review-agent never writes; orchestrator owns all writes via /z-suggest-memory.
review-agent returns exactly one fenced JSON block; any other form is treated as malformed.
review-agent parent_command=debug: debug_md_path is primary artifact; spec_path is supplementary.
bisect-isolator always runs git bisect reset in a finally-block trap; never leaves repo in bisect-in-progress state.
bisect-isolator runs a sanity gate verifying the repro inverts across the range before git bisect run.
bisect-isolator never interprets the offending commit; returns SHA+diff only; why-it-broke analysis belongs to caller.
implementer's cross_task_notes target task must exist in the same TASKS.md; absent target is logged and silently skipped.
spec-precheck and reviewer both consume relevant_docs LLM JSONs as a second source of truth alongside SPEC.
scope-probe is advisory only; the orchestrator owns the final dispatch decision, including whether to treat a low-confidence classification as MEDIUM.
scope-probe never invents axis names; only names from the caller-supplied axis_taxonomy or the special value 'none' on refusal are valid returns.
scope-probe archive file is written before the live file (archive-first invariant); if archive write fails, Phase 0 aborts and the host command proceeds as MEDIUM.
scope-reconciler-audit never smooths over chunk dissent; both conflicting findings appear verbatim in the Cross-chunk dissent section.
scope-reconciler-audit never writes to disk; it returns REPORT.md content and CHUNK_ARTIFACTS for the orchestrator to persist.
scope-reconciler-brainstorm always sets chosen_framing: pending; any other value is a spec violation.
scope-reconciler-brainstorm never drops a failed chunk silently; every chunk ID from the input array must appear as either a Chunk or Chunk FAILED section.
gotchas: codex-consultant.md, gemini-consultant.md, and codex-reviewer.md are stale names.
check-timeout.sh is sourced by proxy agents; missing timeout/gtimeout leaves TIMEOUT_CMD empty.
planning-router must not infer missing quantitative signals from filesystem exploration.
doc-updater dry-run returns proposed docs; /z-maintain-docs decides whether to write them.
external-lookup's canonical contract is lookup-contract.json, not only inline agent prose.
remote-runner refuses DB writes, real-money operations, destructive ops, and interpretive work.
remote-runner refuses naked binary restarts; must use qtctl up <paper-manifest>, not direct binary invocation.
mr-reviewer never writes MR-REVIEW.md; callers parse its fenced JSON response.
mr-reviewer Opus sub-pass fires only when mode=abstraction-only AND deep=true; otherwise Grep+definition check is sufficient.
plan-style-reviewer: dismissed_signatures.json suppresses previously dismissed findings via Jaccard >= 0.6 match.
plan-style-reviewer: voices that return malformed JSON are logged as plan_style_voice_failed and skipped (no retry).
spec-precheck validates factual SPEC references, not design quality or runtime semantics.
doc-fetcher Ripgrep is a soft dependency; falls back to Python word-boundary scan if rg is missing.

review-agent caps candidates at 3 and emits [] rather than padding; slug anti-patterns banned (PR-number refs, library-name-alone, session-specific names, negative-capability claims, model-specific slugs).
review-agent debug mode: debug_md_path must be passed when parent_command=debug; absent for implement-all/review-all.
bisect-isolator refusal checks use POSIX-ERE split patterns (not Perl lookaheads) for macOS/BSD grep compat.
bisect-isolator returns bisect_unusable (not refused) when the repro does not invert across the good/bad ref range.
bisect-isolator captures ORIG_HEAD before any checkout and installs cleanup_bisect trap covering refusal-after-checkout paths.
consultant modes generate-hypotheses-round1 and generate-hypotheses-round2-adversarial return RAW (no standard wrapper); callers must parse provider output directly.
implementer's cross_task_notes are optional; omitting the field or emitting [] is backward-compatible.
scope-probe caps walked candidates at 4 to keep context cheap; walking more than 4 is a violation.
scope-probe makes at most one doc-fetcher call (step 4); chaining doc-fetcher calls is a violation.
scope-probe output must have exactly one fenced JSON block; line-prefix headers (STATUS, MODE, AXIS, etc.) must appear before the fence, never inside it.
scope-probe returns STATUS: refused + MODE: MEDIUM when axis evidence is insufficient — this is not an error, it is the correct graceful-degradation path.
scope-reconciler-audit severity elevation applies only to systemic non-dissent findings (same normalized_evidence_key in ≥2 distinct chunks); dissent findings are never elevated.

scope-reconciler-audit normalization (lowercase, collapse whitespace, strip line-number prefix, truncate to 200 chars) is an internal computation only; the original quoted evidence is always written to REPORT.md.
scope-reconciler-brainstorm anti-bias check (sections A through D) is mandatory even when findings are empty; skipping any sub-check makes the output less trustworthy than a single chunk's output.
scope-reconciler-brainstorm: a Claude-favoring pick requires a concrete justification naming what Claude said that peers did not; a generic preference is not accepted as justification.
